title: OpenAI Decisions GA: Migrate Structured Routing - AI Daily Diff Oct 26
closing_line: Recalibrate on labeled cases before enabling actions. Follow AI Daily Diff for verified builder updates.

items.headline: Move a beta routing evaluation to structured evidence without stringifying business records.
items.what_changed: On October 22, Decisions became generally available with JSON input, per-question images, shared-input caching and up to 400 questions per request.
items.why_it_matters: Builders can evaluate many independent checks against the same structured evidence while keeping typed answers and application actions separate.
items.who_should_care: Developers migrating a Decisions beta evaluation or designing high-volume review and routing workflows.

diff.minus: The October beta accepted up to 200 questions and required structured records to be converted into other supported input forms.
diff.plus: GA accepts input_json, supports question-specific images and doubles the independent-question limit to 400.

items.watch_out: Only gpt-6-luna is currently supported. Dependent questions need separate requests, and thresholds must be calibrated on labeled examples. We did not call the API live.

walkthrough.use_case: Migrate a support-ticket routing evaluation so a ticket and its order record are sent as JSON evidence, then ask separate predicate and choice questions before any refund or routing action.
walkthrough.steps:
Send a user message containing input_text plus an input_json part with the ticket and order record.
Define observable predicate, choice or score questions; group only independent questions that share the same evidence.
Handle refusals and read each typed answer, confidence or probability before application logic.
Replay a labeled set from the beta evaluation and choose review thresholds based on false-positive and false-negative costs.
Inspect cached-input usage when the same evidence is reused; keep actions disabled until the migration results are reviewed.
walkthrough.availability: Generally available through POST /v1/decisions with gpt-6-luna. OpenAI API access, billing, rate limits and regional conditions apply.
walkthrough.limitations: No live API request, accuracy test, latency benchmark or cost measurement. Files, audio and item references are not supported as Decisions input, and dependent questions require separate requests.
walkthrough.evidence_label: OpenAI GA documentation reviewed; no live API test.

youtube_description:
OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available on October 22. This builder briefing explains what changed since the October beta and how to migrate a typed routing evaluation without treating a valid answer as permission to act.

- Pass ticket and order records directly with input_json instead of flattening structured evidence into text.
- Group independent predicate, choice or score questions that share the same evidence; GA supports up to 400 questions per request, up from 200 in beta.
- Use per-question images when each check needs its own visual evidence.
- Reuse shared input where prompt caching fits, then inspect actual cached-input usage.
- Replay labeled cases and set human-review thresholds from the cost of false positives and false negatives before enabling refunds, routing or other actions.

Only gpt-6-luna is currently supported. Dependent questions require separate requests. This is a documented migration walkthrough, not a live API test, accuracy result, latency benchmark or cost measurement.

GA changelog: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog
Decisions guide: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions
